verses.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਖਟ ਦਰਸ ਨ ਦੇਖੇ ਸਕਲ ਦਰਸ ਸਮ ਦਰਸ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sree gur dharas dhiaan khaT dharas na dhekhe sakal dharas sam dharas dhikhaae hai ||

en.bdb: One who has fixed his attention on the vision of the True Guru. is not reassured by the six schools of philosophy nor towards other religious sects. He sees all philosophies in the vision of one True Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੰਮਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਬਦ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਮਝਾਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sree gur sabadh pa(n)ch sabadh giaan ga(n)m sarab sabadh anahadh samajhaae hai ||

en.bdb: One who has received Guru's consecration hears melodies of five types of musical instruments deep in his soul because the unstruck music that has appeared in his being due to perpetual meditation on Lord's name has all the melodies in it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਪਰਵੇਸ ਕੈ ਅਵੇਸ ਰਿਦੈ ਆਦਿ ਕਉ ਆਦੇਸ ਕੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: ma(n)tr upadhes paraves kai aves ridhai aadh kau aadhes kai braham brahamaae hai ||

en.bdb: By practicing meditation on the Lord, He comes and resides he in the heart. In this state an initiated disciple sees the all-pervading Lord everywhere.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਰਸਿਕ ਹੁਇ ਏਕ ਅਉ ਅਨੇਕ ਕੇ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਏ ਹੈ ॥੨੧੪॥
verses.translit_en: giaan dhiaan simaran prem ras rasik hui ek aau anek ke bibek pragaTaae hai ||214||

en.bdb: The Sikh who is blessed with knowledge, contemplation and Simran by the True Guru and who relishes the loving elixir, learns the truth of one Lord who pervades in all despite being one. (214)
